paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between original Consistency-CE model and ours proposed Consistency-Bi model for wait-1 testing under prefix-constrained decoding setting.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the BLEU scores of two models—Consistency-CE and Consistency-Bi—across varying lengths of the gold prefix, with the x-axis representing "the length of gold prefix" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," measures model performance on a linear scale from 23 to 29, with major gridlines every 1 unit. The Consistency-CE model, represented by a blue dashed line with circle markers, begins at a BLEU score of approximately 24.8 at a prefix length of 0, dips to around 24.1 at length 1, then rises to about 25.2 at length 2, and continues to increase steadily, reaching a peak of approximately 28.1 at length 20. In contrast, the Consistency-Bi model, shown as a red solid line with square markers, starts at a BLEU score of about 27.8 at length 0, remains relatively stable between 27.8 and 28.1 until length 6, then declines sharply to approximately 24.0 at length 20. The legend in the lower right corner identifies the blue dashed line as "Consistency-CE" and the red solid line as "Consistency-Bi."
